title: Collect responses
subtitle: Share this form with the people you want to hear from.

draft.title: This form is a draft
draft.description: Visitors opening the link will see “form not found”. Publish it to start collecting responses.

whoCanRespond.label: Who can respond

anyone.label: Anyone with the link
anyone.hint: No sign-in. Responses are anonymous unless you ask for an email in the form.

anyoneWithEmail.label: Anyone with the link — record their email
anyoneWithEmail.hint: Respondents sign in so their verified email is saved with the response.

signIn.label: Only people who sign in
signIn.hint: Respondents must sign in. Optionally limit them to specific email domains.

domains.label: Limit to these email domains (optional)
domains.help: Comma-separated. Leave empty to allow any signed-in respondent.
domains.invalidMessage: “{{domain}}” is not a valid domain (expected e.g. example.com).

whoCanRespond.ownerOnly: Only the form owner can change who can respond.

link.label: Form link
link.help: Anyone allowed by the setting above can open this link and submit the form.
